== Player photographs (2026-10-16) ==
Dested identified player photographs from Players Committee wrap-up articles on starwarsccg.org. Captions name the people; group shots sit on the event page and crops sit on person pages that had no photograph. Devon Hubner memorial portrait from Remembering Devon Hubner (1978-2024). Charlie Arlandson crop from the labeled 2022 U.S. National Championship Top 8 (fifth, NIV shirt). 2024 World Championship already had a winner/runner-up File, so that pair was not re-uploaded. Unlabeled group crops (Casper Jørgensen, Kendall Hallman) were not dested onto person pages.
